name: Figurine of Wondrous Power, Goat of Terror

text.plain: A Figurine of Wondrous Power is a pocket-sized statuette that becomes its specified living creature when thrown to the ground with a Magic action. This figurine can become a Giant Goat for up to 3 hours. The goat can't attack, but its horns can become a +1 Lance and a +2 Longsword. While you ride it, hostile creatures in its 30-foot Emanation face its DC 15 Wisdom saving throw against the Frightened condition. Once used, it can't be used again until 15 days have passed.
